properties.name: Debris flow to the road
properties.description: A debris flow that broke away in two prongs on the hills west of Lel Hla, ran 1.2 km east down a forested valley, scouring it to grey sand, and reached the road at the south end of the village; its fan crossed the road (LL-OW1).

properties.name: Gardens east of the road under sediment
properties.description: Gardens and scrub east of the road, green on 10 Jan 2026, now under the sand of LL-01's fan.
